description: Designing and deploying production AI systems processing 100K+ of daily requests. Reduced inference costs by 60% through model optimization and intelligent caching.

Led architecture and deployment of production RAG and agentic retrieval systems, optimizing retrieval, caching, and database execution paths to deliver scalable, low-latency real-time inference across high-concurrency workloads.

Built an AI-driven agentic QA automation and RAG-powered query platform for BI systems, transforming business requirements into validated SQL through a test-first multi-agent workflow, significantly improving query accuracy and enabling scalable, production-grade analytics automation while achieving 10x faster query execution and 3x higher system throughput.

Developed backend services and internal BI tooling for an inventory and operations platform using FastAPI and PostgreSQL, improving data processing reliability and automating operational workflows to enable real-time monitoring and reduce manual operational overhead.
